items.title: Monitor Valkey clusters with OpenTelemetry metrics in Amazon ElastiCache
items.summary: Amazon ElastiCache for Valkey now offers OpenTelemetry metrics, detailed monitoring, ElastiCache Insights, and PromQL. This post walks through one troubleshooting path: turn on detailed monitoring, find a hot shard, query with PromQL, catch a short latency spike, and create one alarm that watches every node.
items.creator: Paul Ross

items.title: Amazon ElastiCache Serverless turns three
items.summary: In this post, we look back at three years of Amazon ElastiCache Serverless, show how customers use it, cover what we launched this year and how we patch your cache with minimal disruption, show how to estimate what it costs, and help you decide whether it fits your workload.
items.creator: Karthik Konaparthi
